text.en:
Act Numbered Three hundred and seventy, entitled "An Act reducing the thirty-three existing
municipalities in the Province of Bohol to fifteen," is hereby amended as follows:
(a) By striking out of the title and section one the word "thirty-three" and substituting therefor
the word "thirty-five," and by striking out the word "fifteen" and substituting thereof the word
(b) By amending subsection fourteen of section one to read as follows:
" 14. The municipality of Antequera and the entire barrio of Tanopol, of the municipalities of
Balilihan and Katigbiyan, are hereby consolidated with the municipality of Balilihan, under the
name of Balilihan. "
